entries.name: Submit Leave Request with Missing Dates

observations.body: Dashboard shows welcome text, leave balance 18 days, 0 pending leave requests and quick actions for Request leave and Fill timesheet. Global navigation links to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile; Notifications shows a count of 3.
Opening the Dashboard route first showed Loading before its summary and quick actions settled.

Directory initially loads a loading indicator, then shows 28 employees in a table with name, department, title and email; rows appear alphabetically by name. Search by name and a department selector (All departments, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR) are available. Page 1 of 3 shows ten records; Previous is disabled and Next is enabled. The first ten listed include Abigail Stone through Hannah Blake.
Returning to Directory opens the unfiltered first page with 28 employees, all departments selected, and Next enabled.
Selecting Engineering in the directory department filter returns eight Engineering employees on page 1 of 1, and both pagination buttons are disabled.

Clicking Next in the unfiltered directory shows page 2 of 3 with ten alphabetized employee rows, from Julia Romero through Samuel Turner; Previous and Next are enabled and the total remains 28 employees.
Returning to Directory first displayed Loading before the first unfiltered page settled.
Selecting Engineering from the directory's own department options filters the table to eight Engineering employees on one page.
Clicking Next from the unfiltered first directory page shows page 2 of 3 with ten alphabetized employees, from Julia Romero through Samuel Turner.
On directory page 2 of 3, Next is enabled to continue to the final page.
Directory is on page 2 of 3 with Next enabled; I am opening the final page.
Clicking Next from page 2 shows the final page, page 3 of 3, with seven alphabetized rows from Tara Lindqvist through Zach Miller; Next is disabled and Previous is enabled.
Entering Emily in Search by name returns one employee, Emily Dawson of Engineering, on page 1 of 1; both pagination buttons are disabled.

My Leave shows an available balance of 18 days and states that days are deducted when a request is approved. Request history contains one approved 3-day Vacation request for Aug 11�12, 2026, with manager comment �Approved � enjoy!�. A New request link opens leave request creation.
Opening My Leave first displayed Loading before the balance and request history settled.
Selecting My Leave from the profile navigation opens the leave page with an 18-day balance and the existing approved vacation request.
Clicking New request opens New Leave Request with Vacation selected and empty required date fields.
New request reached the New Leave Request form.

New leave request offers required Leave type (Vacation selected; Sick and Personal are options), required Start date and End date, optional Reason, Submit request and Cancel. The form says weekends are not counted toward leave. Date inputs are currently empty and read-only in the captured state.
Selecting the read-only Start date field opens a September 2026 date picker with weekday headings and numbered days; the date inputs remain empty until a calendar day is chosen.
Opening the new leave request route first displayed a Loading indicator, then settled into the leave type, date, reason and submission form.
The new request form is empty and the start-date calendar is open on September 2026; I am selecting an October 2026 leave date for Emily's disposable synthetic request.
The browser wrapper could not locate the rendered next-month glyph as exact text, so no date was selected and the Product form stayed unchanged.

look.reason: The observed calendar next-month glyph could not be targeted by the wrapper; the click timed out before Product dispatch.

observations.body: Reopening New leave request resets the form to Vacation selected with empty Start date, End date and Reason fields; Cancel is available.
Clicking Cancel on the blank request form returned to My Leave and left the existing 18-day balance and one approved request unchanged.
Cancel returned to the My Leave page.
The new leave request form has empty Start date, End date and Reason fields with Vacation selected; I am checking Submit request with the required dates empty.
Submitting with required dates empty stays on New Leave Request and shows �Please fill in all required fields.�; no request appears in history and the fields remain empty.
Timesheet displays the week of Sep 7, 2026 as a draft with seven weekday hour inputs, all 0, Total: 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
Opening Timesheet first displayed Loading before the weekly draft and hour inputs settled.
Returning to Timesheet loads the Sep 7, 2026 draft with all seven weekday values at 0 and total 0 h.
The Sep 7 timesheet is a draft with all hours currently zero; I am entering 8 hours on Monday for the synthetic draft.
Entering 8 in Monday immediately updates the displayed total to 8 h; the week remains marked draft and the other six days stay at 0.
Monday shows 8 hours and the total is 8 h on the Sep 7 draft; I am saving this synthetic draft.
Clicking Save draft returned �Draft saved.�; Monday remains 8 h, the other days remain 0 and the status remains draft.
Returning to Timesheet first displayed Loading before the Sep 7 draft settled.
The saved Sep 7 timesheet draft persists after reloading: Monday is 8 hours, the other six weekdays are 0, total is 8 h, and the status is draft.
After reload the Sep 7 draft still has Monday 8 h and 0 h on each other day; I am submitting this synthetic weekly timesheet.

Submit week changed the Sep 7 timesheet to submitted, showed �This week's timesheet has been submitted and can no longer be edited.� and �Timesheet submitted.�, and disabled all hour fields and both actions; total remains 8 h.
My Profile shows editable full name, phone and emergency-contact fields, a disabled read-only email, an Upload photo action and Save changes.
Opening My Profile first showed Loading before the profile fields settled.
Filling the editable Phone field with the temporary synthetic value 555-0199 changes only the unsaved form value; Save changes remains available and was not activated.
The Phone field is editable, currently contains the unsaved temporary value, and Save changes is available.
The temporary value is unsaved and no Save changes action occurred; I am restoring the original phone value in the form.
The Phone field is restored to its original value 555-0107; the form shows the original profile data and Save changes remains available but was not used, so no profile update was sent.
The Phone field again contains its original value and other profile fields match their initial values; I am checking Save changes with this unchanged profile.
Saving the unchanged original profile returns �Profile saved.�; the original phone value remains, the email remains disabled and read-only, and no profile field was changed.

Notifications lists three messages: Emily's vacation request approved by Michael Reed on Aug 13, 2026; a reminder to submit this week's timesheet on Sep 7, 2026; and a notice that remote-work guidelines were updated on Sep 9, 2026.
Opening Notifications first showed Loading before the three messages settled.
